book_cn: 上外版选择性必修第三册
unit_cn: Unit 4 Protecting the Environment 保护环境
source: 上外版选择性必修三 Unit 4 词表(真词,跳过专有名词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、环境保护主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: We should all do something to protect the environment.
words.example_cn: 我们都应为保护环境做点事。

words.example_en: Too much carbon dioxide in the atmosphere causes the greenhouse effect.
words.example_cn: 大气中过多的二氧化碳会引发温室效应。

words.example_en: Burning coal and oil releases a great deal of carbon dioxide.
words.example_cn: 燃烧煤和石油会释放大量二氧化碳。

words.example_en: The concentration of carbon dioxide in the air is going up steadily.
words.example_cn: 空气中二氧化碳的浓度在稳步上升。

words.example_en: The Earth's surface absorbs sunlight and is warmed by it.
words.example_cn: 地球表面吸收阳光并因此变暖。

words.example_en: At night the Earth cools as it radiates heat into space.
words.example_cn: 夜间地球向太空辐射热量而冷却下来。

words.example_en: Carbon dioxide tends to block the radiation that should leave the Earth.
words.example_cn: 二氧化碳往往会阻挡本应离开地球的辐射。

words.example_en: Gases like carbon dioxide cause the greenhouse effect.
words.example_cn: 二氧化碳等气体会造成温室效应。

words.example_en: The greenhouse effect has a serious effect on our climate.
words.example_cn: 温室效应对我们的气候有严重影响。

words.example_en: Factories release harmful gases into the air every day.
words.example_cn: 工厂每天向空气中排放有害气体。

words.example_en: Many countries are trying hard to reduce their carbon emissions.
words.example_cn: 许多国家正努力减少碳排放。

words.example_en: The burning of fossil fuels adds more carbon dioxide to the air.
words.example_cn: 燃烧化石燃料会向空气中增加更多二氧化碳。

words.example_en: Scientists estimate that the temperature will keep rising.
words.example_cn: 科学家估计气温将持续上升。

words.example_en: A large quantity of waste enters the ocean every year.
words.example_cn: 每年有大量废弃物进入海洋。

words.example_en: If the food supply drops, starvation will become widespread.
words.example_cn: 如果粮食供应减少,饥荒将变得普遍。

words.example_en: The Earth's average temperature is going up steadily.
words.example_cn: 地球的平均气温在稳步上升。

words.example_en: Each year the level of the gas has moved upwards.
words.example_cn: 这种气体的含量每年都在上升。

words.example_en: In the coming decades the climate may change greatly.
words.example_cn: 在未来几十年里气候可能会大幅改变。

words.meaning_cn: (天气)温和的;温和的;不严重的
words.example_en: As the planet warms, winters will grow a bit milder.
words.example_cn: 随着地球变暖,冬天会变得稍微温和一些。

words.example_en: Little by little, the glaciers will retreat as the air gets warmer.
words.example_cn: 随着空气变暖,冰川会一点点退缩。

words.example_en: Scientists have watched the ice retreat year after year.
words.example_cn: 科学家年复一年地看着冰退去。

words.example_en: The polar ice caps have begun to melt because of global warming.
words.example_cn: 由于全球变暖,极地冰盖已开始融化。

words.example_en: The melting of the ice caps demonstrates the danger of carbon dioxide.
words.example_cn: 冰盖的融化说明了二氧化碳的危险。

words.example_en: Most marine waste is plastic from bottles and packaging.
words.example_cn: 大多数海洋垃圾是来自瓶子和包装的塑料。

words.example_en: Buying products with less packaging helps the environment.
words.example_cn: 购买包装较少的产品有助于保护环境。

words.example_en: In many cities, garbage sorting is now part of daily life.
words.example_cn: 在许多城市,垃圾分类如今已是日常生活的一部分。

words.example_en: Some turtles eat plastic bags because they look like jellyfish.
words.example_cn: 一些海龟会吃塑料袋,因为它们看起来像水母。

words.example_en: To a sea turtle, a floating plastic bag can look like a jellyfish.
words.example_cn: 对海龟来说,漂浮的塑料袋看起来像水母。

words.example_en: Carbon dioxide can block the heat that should leave the Earth.
words.example_cn: 二氧化碳会阻挡本应离开地球的热量。

words.example_en: Plastic waste may poison the animals that swallow it.
words.example_cn: 塑料垃圾可能毒害吞食它的动物。

words.example_en: A survey showed that half of green turtles eat rubbish.
words.example_cn: 一项调查显示,半数绿海龟会吃下垃圾。

words.example_en: Six species of sea turtle are already threatened with extinction.
words.example_cn: 六种海龟已濒临灭绝。

words.example_en: The ocean sustains us with the basic elements of life.
words.example_cn: 海洋以生命的基本要素维持着我们。

words.example_en: Using less is a step towards more sustainable development.
words.example_cn: 少用一些是迈向更可持续发展的一步。

words.example_en: Clean water and air are basic elements of life.
words.example_cn: 洁净的水和空气是生命的基本要素。

words.example_en: The ocean is an essential part of the water cycle.
words.example_cn: 海洋是水循环中不可或缺的一部分。

words.example_en: Sea animals can become trapped in rubbish floating in the water.
words.example_cn: 海洋动物可能被漂在水中的垃圾困住。

words.example_en: The rising sea level is one serious consequence of global warming.
words.example_cn: 海平面上升是全球变暖的一个严重后果。

words.meaning_cn: 环境保护论者;环保人士
words.example_en: The young environmentalist decided to save the rainforest.
words.example_cn: 这位年轻的环保人士决定拯救雨林。

words.example_en: Few people understand the significance of the rainforests to the Earth.
words.example_cn: 很少有人理解雨林对地球的重要性。

words.example_en: They set up a non-profit group to protect the forest.
words.example_cn: 他们成立了一个非营利组织来保护森林。

words.example_en: Saving the rainforest is a difficult but honourable task.
words.example_cn: 拯救雨林是一项艰难却可敬的任务。

words.example_en: She is optimistic that people can still save the planet together.
words.example_cn: 她乐观地认为人们仍能齐心拯救地球。

words.example_en: Some people are pessimistic about the future of the climate.
words.example_cn: 有些人对气候的未来持悲观态度。

words.example_en: The speaker stayed neutral and did not take either side.
words.example_cn: 演讲者保持中立,不偏向任何一方。

words.example_en: Make sure you use a recycle bin every time.
words.example_cn: 务必每次都使用回收箱。

words.example_en: The Earth may suffer from extreme weather more often.
words.example_cn: 地球可能会更频繁地遭受极端天气。

words.example_en: Global warming is one of the biggest problems we face today.
words.example_cn: 全球变暖是我们当今面临的最大问题之一。
